description: Erection of a detached outbuilding in rear garden for use as a gym
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( 24aCLIFFORDAVENUE 01 (received on 06 August 2019); Location Plan (received 16 September 2019); Proposed site plan; 24aCLIFFORDAVENUEr2 02 (received 08 October 2019) ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the main dwelling(s).

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall not be used for purposes other than those incidental to the properties within the 'red line' (delineating the application site) and shall not be used as primary accommodation such as a living room, bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, study or as a separate unit of accommodation and notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended), no subdivision of the rear garden / amenity space of those properties shall occur.
